title: LET'S USE OUR RESOURCES WITH CARE / HORROR! BLOODY MANSION SLAUGHTER DANCE
overview: While Risu tracks down the Cross-Eyes' hideout, Kasukabe's group heads off to find the professor's estranged wife, only to make a gruesome discovery.

title: MEOTO ZENZAI / MASTEMA SUBNADE / THE TRAGIC TALE OF THE CROSS-EYES
overview: The battle heats up as Shin and Noi fight for their lives. Caiman and Nikaido find themselves being followed as they explore a bustling underground city.

title: SWEET HOME / SHINING YOUTH / MEMORIES KEEP CIRCLING ROUND AND ROUND / COME BACK HOME
overview: Ebisu regains her memories after eating En's new product. Meanwhile, Caiman experiences a violent flashback and Kasukabe goes grave-digging in the Hole.

title: GOLDEN BEETLES ARE RICH / CUTE BUTCHER / DOOR TO THE PAST
overview: So the Cross-Eyes gang figured they’d make the landlord’s murder look like a suicide, huh? As for Asu, who dared to keep things from me, I made sure he paid for it.

title: MEETING IN THE RAIN / TRAVEL COMPANIONS / FINAL NIGHT FOR TWO
overview: Looks like Ebisu got her memory back, thanks to eating some weird mushrooms, and now she’s all eager to head back to her parents’ place.

title: FAREWELL, CAIMAN / MEMORY BUBBLES
overview: En’s found the lizard guy and Nikaido, and they’re going at it hard. Meanwhile, the Cross-Eyes guys are sitting around swapping stories about their boss.

title: MY SECRET PLAN / CROSS-EYE EXPEDITION / DEFORMED REUNION
overview: Fujita's losing his mind trying to get Kikurage to bring Ebisu back to life. The Cross-Eyes guys are scrambling for cash, and things around En are starting to get kind of dicey.

title: CHAOS SHOCK / BLACK BOX / ROOM 501
overview: I never imagined En would go down that easily. The sorcerers are thrown into total chaos. And now I get why Nikaido doesn't use magic.

title: MOSH PIT / CROSS-EYES IN THE NEWS
overview: The Cross-Eyes boss has finally shown up. The En Family's been wiped out, and it looks like the Cross-Eyes have taken over that huge mansion.

title: LUCKY JERK / ADVANCED MAGIC
overview: Looks like they've found missing Kikurage. And that bastard Asu, well, Kawajiri now, is sneaking around, up to something weird again. That Haru chick’s getting a little too carried away.

title: BALLAD OF THE HAPPY DESTRUCTION / QUESTION & ANSWER
overview: Looks like Kawajiri and Nikaido have slipped into En's mansion, which the Cross-Eyes have taken over. There, Nikaido runs right into Aikawa. The mystery surrounding the Cross-Eyes boss just keeps getting deeper.
